description: Search Manifold Markets prediction markets by topic or question text. Returns markets with current probability (for binary), trading volume, liquidity, bettor count, and resolution status. Manifold is a play-money venue with tens of thousands of user-created markets on any topic. Keyless.

contract_type.description: Market type filter: ALL | BINARY | MULTIPLE_CHOICE. Default "ALL".

filter.description: Market state filter: all | open | closed | resolved. Default "open".

sort.description: Sort order: score | newest | liquidity | most-popular. Default "score".

term.description: Topic or question text to search for, e.g. "2026 election", "AGI", "Bitcoin 100k".

name: search_markets
title: Search Markets
